pins.name: D13
pins.label: GPIO10 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED / LED_BUILTIN - onboard user LED ("D13"), confirmed green and active-high by iLabs' own MkII datasheet ("connected to pin D13 and can easily be controlled by the user program").

pins.name: D14

pins.notes: NEOPIXEL - onboard WS2812 addressable RGB status LED (D14). Confirmed via iLabs' own MkII datasheet ("an RGB LED with intensity control, run by a single GPIO (D14/GPIO11) pin").

pins.name: MISO
pins.label: MISO (GPIO24)
pins.notes: PIN_ESP32_MODE / ESPHOST_DATA_READY - onboard ESP32-C3 WiFi/BLE co-processor's mode-select (AT mode) / data-ready handshake (ESP-hosted mode) line. Not general-purpose. NOTE: this GPIO is also this board's vendor-defined PIN_SPI0_MISO alias; build_boards.js's unconditional spi_miso auto-append will still surface a 'spi_miso' capability on this pin despite this override - a known, flagged, NOT-fixed residual limitation (see board.json header comment) since removing that alias would disable the board's entire default SPI0 object, not just the MISO line.
